archetypes.name: anchor-threading
archetypes.rationale: Checks whether the plan consistently threads the issue scope anchor through every review, vote, revise, and fallback path without substituting brainstorm context.
archetypes.prompt_body: Investigate whether the proposed scope-anchor source and all planned call sites match the actual script boundaries in the listed files. Look for missing argv plumbing, result-env handoff gaps, stale references to brainstorm-merged context, or places where the plan claims uniform anchoring but evidence suggests a stage would still see only the drifting plan. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: marker-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: Targets defects in the proposed [SCOPE-REDUCTION] marker contract across detection, deduplication, aggregation, tallying, and MainAgent fallback.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace the planned leading-marker contract from reviewer prompt generation through dedup, aggregation, vote tally, accepted-artifact emission, and classification TSV behavior. Look for schema mismatches, lossy transformations, false-positive detector assumptions, or plan steps that cannot preserve the marker as described. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: shared-compat
archetypes.rationale: Reviews whether shared voter and tally script changes remain backward-compatible for non-design consumers as the plan claims.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the plan's shared-script changes against the repository surfaces that call those scripts outside /design. Look for omitted default-path tests, new flags that could alter byte-identical prompts, or design-specific logic leaking into /review, /research, or /implement flows. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
